Figure 2:Observability levels inMole.Each service call can be viewed at three
cumulative levels. Audit events include the recorded call and its arguments; tool results add
returned content; agent reasoning adds the model’s reasoning trace.

Figure 5:Monitor capability and observability (R@10/day).Each panel shows one
generator’s multiday campaign corpus. Rows vary the monitor model (GPT-4.1-mini, GPT-4.1, GPT-5.5).
Columns add tool results, agent reasoning, and then the fixed threat taxonomy to audit events.
GPT-5.5 performs best at each matched observability level, yet GPT-4.1 with agent reasoning
outperforms audit-only GPT-5.5 in the Kimi, Qwen, and DeepSeek generator panels.

Figure 6:Threat-level coverage.R@10/day for six monitors (three classical, three semantic)
on the GPT-5.3 single-day campaign corpus. No monitor exceeds 0.43 on the four highlighted threats,
making them the most difficult for the evaluated monitors on this corpus.
